question: Find Small Cell Lung trials with minimum follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC) trials and displays the NCT ID, author, year, PubMed ID, and follow-up durations (overall, treatment arm, and control arm) in ascending order of overall follow-up duration, which enables one to see minimum follow-up easily.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%SCLC%' ORDER BY \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" ASC",
  "answer": "This query retrieves Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC) trials and displays the NCT ID, author, year, PubMed ID, and follow-up durations (overall, treatment arm, and control arm) in ascending order of overall follow-up duration, which enables one to see minimum follow-up easily.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
